text:
sophie: Free Herman Miller Aeron (Size B) — moving out, free to pick up from SF office this Friday. Slight wear on the left armrest, no tears. DM for pics. First come, first served. Will also consider trading for a 27" monitor + a little cash. :heart:

mohit: @sophie would love it if still available! can you drop a pic of the wear?

lia: interested depending on pics. I can pick up after 5pm on Friday.

sophie: posted a quick photo here: https://imgur.com/a/abcd123 (armrest scuff near the seam, everything else solid)

ops-bot: FYI — please move pickup coordination to #office-logistics and add the tag `donation` per office policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/office-donations

marcus: I can trade a 27" Dell U2720Q + $50 if that helps. Monitor is currently in good shape, minimal bezel wear.

mohit: @marcus are you still on Market St? I can meet and help with the swap if needed.

sophie: @marcus that sounds promising — can you post a couple photos of the monitor (back/stand, and one power-on screenshot)?

marcus: photos: https://photos.app.goo.gl/monitor-sample (shows a tiny scratch on the bottom-left bezel, no dead pixels). I'll be in the office Thu afternoon.

lia: if the trade doesn't go through, I'm still available to pick up Fri 6pm.

mohit: also happy to take the chair off your hands for free if Marcus falls through — no cash necessary, @sophie.

noelle: awesome — great to see stuff being reused instead of trashed :clap:

sophie: leaning toward the trade with @marcus, will DM to confirm and mark thread when it's claimed. thanks everyone! :party_parrot:

sophie: UPDATE: marked as promised to Marcus. If anything changes I'll post here and move the pickup to #office-logistics per ops-bot.
